description: GA4 MCP that reads AND writes: reports, funnels, audits, and server-side events. 26 tools.
name: io.github.leonardosepulvedat/mcp-google-analytics

environmentVariables.description: Service account JSON for reading reports: file path or inline JSON (needed for read tools)
environmentVariables.name: GA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON

environmentVariables.description: Numeric GA4 property ID, e.g. 123456789 (needed for read tools)
environmentVariables.name: GA_PROPERTY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Measurement ID of the data stream, e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX (needed for event-sending tools)
environmentVariables.name: GA_MEASUREMENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Measurement Protocol API secret (needed for event-sending tools)
environmentVariables.name: GA_API_SECRET
